title: Scrimmage Manifest
description: Schema for a single scrimmage run manifest. Validates scrimmage/<NNNN-slug>/manifest.json. A scrimmage is the live unit of work: one play, one input, one roster, one branch, one PR.

id.description: Zero-padded ordinal followed by kebab-case slug. Must match the parent directory name (scrimmage/<id>/).

title.description: Human-readable title for this specific run.

status.description: draft = manifest not finalized, do not execute. ready = approved for execution, awaiting orchestrator pickup. running = scrimmage in progress. review = outputs produced, awaiting principal review. merged = PR merged, scrimmage closed. abandoned = will not run, kept for history.

paths.description: Paths the scrimmage reads. May be outside the scrimmage workspace. Always relative or absolute, never bare names.

read_only.description: Whether the input is strictly read-only. For inputs outside the scrimmage workspace, must be true.

snapshot_hash.description: Optional sha256 of the input state at scrimmage start. Useful when the input mutates over time.

role.description: What this agent is doing in this scrimmage. Examples: 'reader', 'synthesizer', 'devils-advocate', 'rapporteur'.

role_brief.description: Optional scrimmage-specific instructions appended to the agent's normal system prompt.

protocol_overrides.description: Optional overrides on the play's default protocol for this specific scrimmage.

branch.description: Git branch for this scrimmage. Convention: scrimmage/<id>.

paths.description: Output paths within the scrimmage workspace. All paths must start with scrimmage/<id>/output/.

log.description: Pointer to the scrimmage's human-readable run log.

path.description: Path relative to the scrimmage directory.
